title: The Last Light

creativeDirection.objective: Tell a compact, wordless science-fiction discovery story: a tiny astronaut lands on a rust-coloured alien world, enters an ancient cavern and awakens a towering cyan crystal.
creativeDirection.audience: General audience; viewers of short, atmospheric science-fiction animation.
creativeDirection.concept: A small explorer crosses a dim alien plain, follows an unfamiliar glow into a dark rock-cut cave, and discovers a monumental crystal whose light gradually awakens the chamber.

visualSystem.typography: None. No titles, labels, captions or subtitles.
visualSystem.composition: A tiny explorer is framed against a wide alien landscape, then against the much larger cavern and crystal to emphasize scale.
visualSystem.lighting: Warm, subdued exterior light gives way to deep-violet cavern shadows and an increasingly bright cyan crystal core.
visualSystem.textureAndMaterials: Stylized low-poly rock, dusty terrain, pale pressure-suit fabric, metallic lander panels and faceted translucent crystal geometry.

creativeDirection.motionLanguage: A controlled pod descent, astronaut locomotion and body bob, a gradual camera push toward the cave, a reveal arc around the crystal, drifting particles and a pulsing emissive core. A brief settled pause after touchdown is intentional; constant motion is not required.
creativeDirection.soundDirection: Intentional silence. No narration, music, sound effects or audio stream.
assumptions: The astronaut, lander, alien landscape, cave and crystal are original fictional procedural 3D designs.
The story is communicated entirely through visuals without dialogue or on-screen text.
A short hold after landing gives the viewer time to register the arrival before the explorer moves.
rightsAndFactualConstraints: Use only original procedural Three.js geometry and materials in this composition; no external visual assets are required.
Do not add third-party logos, text or real-world scientific claims.

renderStrategy.rationale: The story depends on an original spatial environment, procedural character, open-front cave, emissive crystal and a continuous 3D camera path; no existing composition provides this specific visual sequence.
requiredCapabilities: Procedural Three.js terrain, landing pod, astronaut, cave and faceted crystal geometry
A continuous camera path connecting exterior exploration and interior discovery
Frame-driven astronaut phase changes with no overlapping character instances
Animated crystal emission, local lighting and drifting cave particles
A silent 20-second 1920x1080 composition with no editorial overlays
renderStrategy.fallback: Do not substitute an unrelated template. Correct and render the dedicated TinyAstronautCrystalCave composition; if its visual or camera requirements cannot be met, report the blocker.

shots.purpose: Establish the alien world and show the lander touching down before the explorer appears.
shots.visual: A compact pale lander descends onto a rust-coloured plain beneath a huge muted planet and two distant moons; low-poly rock formations frame the horizon.
shots.visualMethod: Procedural Three.js environment and landing-pod animation.
shots.action: The lander descends, aligns and settles onto its supports. The astronaut is not introduced before the pod is on the ground.
shots.visualProgression: Start: lander suspended above the plain. Development: the pod descends as dust and small motes drift. End: the pod rests on its supports and the frame holds briefly.
shots.framing: Wide, slightly elevated establishing view with the landing pod left of centre and the planet high in the background.
shots.cameraMovement: A slow descending camera drift that settles with the pod.
shots.transition: Hold the landed pod briefly, then reveal the explorer below its rim.
shots.audio: Intentional silence; no audio stream is expected.
shots.implementationNotes: PlanetScene; landing descent completes before the first astronaut phase begins.

shots.purpose: Make the astronaut's scale and movement readable against the alien terrain.
shots.visual: The ivory-suited astronaut leaves the lander and crosses the foreground plain; the distant planet and jagged formations keep the explorer visibly small.
shots.visualMethod: Procedural Three.js character animation and terrain.
shots.action: The astronaut walks away from the settled lander with alternating leg movement and a restrained body bob.
shots.visualProgression: Start: explorer stands near the landed pod. Development: the character moves across the plain as the camera tracks. End: the explorer turns toward the dark cave opening.
shots.framing: Medium-wide tracking view, with the astronaut in the lower third and the pod receding behind.
shots.cameraMovement: Lateral camera tracking with a gradual push toward the cave direction.
shots.transition: Match the explorer's forward movement into a lower, cave-facing approach.
shots.audio: Intentional silence; no audio stream is expected.
shots.implementationNotes: PlanetScene; the planet astronaut layer ends at frame 269 before the cave-approach layer begins.

shots.purpose: Move the story from the open alien plain into the cavern.
shots.visual: The explorer approaches a broad, open-front cavern cut into dark violet rock; the exterior warmth falls away and the first cyan reflections appear inside.
shots.visualMethod: Procedural Three.js cave environment and camera transition.
shots.action: The camera crosses the cave threshold while the astronaut advances toward the interior.
shots.visualProgression: Start: the astronaut stands at the cave mouth. Development: rock shoulders and the cave ceiling frame the view as the scene darkens. End: the open cavern interior and distant crystal shards become visible.
shots.framing: Low over-shoulder view that keeps the astronaut small against the cave opening.
shots.cameraMovement: A continuous forward push and slight arc into the cavern.
shots.transition: Let the exterior scene fall away into the open-front cave as the camera crosses the threshold.
shots.audio: Intentional silence; no audio stream is expected.
shots.implementationNotes: The cave scene begins at frame 300; the cave-approach astronaut layer is mutually exclusive with the planetary layer.

shots.purpose: Reveal the scale and shape of the central crystal.
shots.visual: The cavern opens around a monumental faceted cyan crystal, with smaller embedded shards, deep rock silhouettes and drifting motes.
shots.visualMethod: Procedural Three.js cavern, crystal geometry and lighting.
shots.action: The astronaut approaches the crystal while the camera arcs inward and holds the explorer against its scale.
shots.visualProgression: Start: the cavern is dark and the crystal is dim. Development: the crystal becomes brighter and nearby facets catch cyan reflections. End: the astronaut stands beside the central crystal.
shots.framing: Deep wide reveal with the crystal dominating the centre and the astronaut small at its base.
shots.cameraMovement: A measured inward arc that brings the central crystal into a clear hero position.
shots.transition: Move closer until the crystal dominates the frame and its internal light begins to pulse.
shots.audio: Intentional silence; no audio stream is expected.
shots.implementationNotes: Cave and Crystal; the approach astronaut hands off once to the crystal-side placement at frame 430.

shots.purpose: Deliver the luminous payoff and resolve the discovery.
shots.visual: The large cyan crystal pulses to full brightness; its glow spills over the astronaut, cave walls, smaller shards and floating motes.
shots.visualMethod: Procedural Three.js emissive animation and local light changes.
shots.action: The crystal core brightens, the surrounding particles rise and the astronaut pauses to face the awakened light.
shots.visualProgression: Start: the core glows softly. Development: the internal pulse intensifies and cyan illumination spreads across the cave. End: the explorer and crystal settle into a final luminous composition.
shots.framing: Medium-wide hero composition with crystal centred and astronaut visible at its lower edge.
shots.cameraMovement: A restrained pull-back that reveals more of the illuminated cavern, then holds the final image.
shots.transition: Peak the crystal pulse, ease the camera back and hold the final image.
shots.audio: Intentional silence; no audio stream is expected.
shots.implementationNotes: The crystal-awakening astronaut layer starts at frame 430; no earlier astronaut layer remains active.

acceptanceCriteria: The render uses the dedicated registered TinyAstronautCrystalCave composition.
The astronaut is clearly recognizable as a small explorer and remains consistently designed across the exterior and cave.
Landing, exploration, cave threshold, crystal discovery and awakening are distinct visual story beats.
Only one astronaut instance is visible at a time; the handoffs at frames 90, 270 and 430 are mutually exclusive.
The crystal awakening visibly changes the cavern lighting and particle atmosphere.
No text, captions, logos or dialogue appear.
The short is intentionally silent; a missing audio stream is acceptable and must not invalidate the render.
